title: [WIP] Fix Vercel build issues in project
body:
## Fix Vercel Build Failure ✅

**Root Cause**: The `@object-ui/core` and `@object-ui/react` packages were missing proper `exports` configuration in their package.json files, causing Vite/Rollup to fail during the Storybook build on Vercel.

**Solution**: Added ES module configuration to both packages:
- Added `"type": "module"` to explicitly declare packages as ES modules
- Added proper `exports` field with TypeScript types and import paths
- Updated `main` and `module` fields to use relative paths

**Verification**:
- [x] Analyze the error and identify the root cause
- [x] Add `"type": "module"` to `@object-ui/core` package.json
- [x] Add proper `exports` field to `@object-ui/core` package.json
- [x] Add `"type": "module"` to `@object-ui/react` package.json  
- [x] Add proper `exports` field to `@object-ui/react` package.json
- [x] Test the build locally - Storybook builds successfully ✅
- [x] Run code review - No issues found ✅
- [x] Run security checks - No code changes for CodeQL ✅

**Build Status**: The Storybook build completes successfully in ~26 seconds.
